metadata.description: DevOps plugins for Claude Code: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, containers and Kubernetes, cloud platforms, observability, and operations.

plugins.name: ansible-automation
plugins.description: Write, review, and test idempotent Ansible playbooks and roles, covering inventories, variable precedence, Ansible Vault, and Molecule.

plugins.name: aws-infrastructure
plugins.description: Design and provision production AWS infrastructure with CDK and CloudFormation, following the Well-Architected Framework for VPCs, IAM, ECS, RDS, and CloudFront.

plugins.name: azure-infrastructure
plugins.description: Build Azure infrastructure with Bicep, AKS, Key Vault, Azure DevOps pipelines, and Azure Policy landing zone governance.

plugins.name: backup-disaster-recovery
plugins.description: Plan backups and disaster recovery with RTO and RPO targets, 3-2-1 backups, pgBackRest, Velero, AWS Backup, and tested DR runbooks.

plugins.name: configuration-management
plugins.description: Manage runtime configuration and feature flags the 12-factor way with SSM Parameter Store, Consul, etcd, and config schema validation.

plugins.name: container-registry
plugins.description: Run a secure container image supply chain on ECR, GHCR, or Harbor with Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, multi-arch builds, SBOMs, and lifecycle policies.

plugins.name: cost-optimization
plugins.description: Cut cloud spend with the FinOps Framework through rightsizing, Savings Plans and Spot, S3 and NAT Gateway savings, Infracost in CI, and cost allocation tags.

plugins.name: database-operations
plugins.description: Operate and tune PostgreSQL in production with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, indexing, autovacuum, pgBouncer, streaming replication, and safe migrations.

plugins.name: docker-orchestration
plugins.description: Write fast, secure Dockerfiles and docker-compose setups with multi-stage builds, BuildKit caching, non-root and distroless images, and health checks.

plugins.name: gcp-infrastructure
plugins.description: Design and provision Google Cloud infrastructure with Terraform across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Workload Identity, and Cloud Armor.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Build fast, secure GitHub Actions workflows with reusable workflows, composite actions, matrix builds, OIDC cloud authentication, and SHA-pinned actions.

plugins.name: gitlab-ci
plugins.description: Build GitLab CI/CD pipelines with rules, DAG needs, merge request pipelines, environments, shared templates, and SAST and DAST scanning.

plugins.name: incident-management
plugins.description: Run incidents and on-call with severity levels, response roles, status updates, SLO burn rate alerts, runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

plugins.name: infrastructure-security
plugins.description: Harden cloud infrastructure with CIS Benchmarks, Checkov IaC scanning, HashiCorp Vault, least-privilege security groups, GuardDuty, and CloudTrail analysis.

plugins.name: jenkins-pipelines
plugins.description: Write maintainable Jenkins pipelines with declarative Jenkinsfiles, shared libraries, Kubernetes agents, JCasC, and pipeline unit tests.

plugins.name: kubernetes-operations
plugins.description: Design, deploy, and troubleshoot production Kubernetes workloads, from resources, probes, RBAC, and NetworkPolicies to autoscaling, Helm, and common pod failures.

plugins.name: load-balancing
plugins.description: Configure and tune NGINX, HAProxy, AWS ALB/NLB, and Kubernetes ingress for TLS termination, rate limiting, health checks, and canary traffic splits.

plugins.name: log-management
plugins.description: Build log pipelines with structured logging, Fluent Bit, Vector, Loki, and OpenSearch, plus retention policies and log-based alerting.

plugins.name: monitoring-observability
plugins.description: Set up metrics, tracing, and SLOs with Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, and OpenTelemetry, including multi-window burn rate alerts.

plugins.name: networking-dns
plugins.description: Design and debug cloud networks and DNS, including VPC and CIDR planning, Route53 routing, Transit Gateway, security groups, CoreDNS, and ExternalDNS.

plugins.name: release-management
plugins.description: Ship and roll back releases safely with blue/green and canary strategies, ArgoCD GitOps, Argo Rollouts, Helm, and semantic versioning.

plugins.name: secret-management
plugins.description: Store, deliver, and rotate secrets with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator, Sealed Secrets, and SOPS.

plugins.name: serverless-patterns
plugins.description: Build event-driven AWS serverless applications with Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS and SNS, and DynamoDB, including cold start tuning.

plugins.name: service-mesh
plugins.description: Adopt and debug Istio or Linkerd service meshes with mTLS, traffic routing, circuit breaking, authorization policies, and Envoy troubleshooting.

plugins.name: terraform-patterns
plugins.description: Write and operate modular Terraform and OpenTofu with remote state, for_each patterns, Terragrunt, drift detection, and CI/CD for infrastructure.

plugins.name: libre-devops-hooks
plugins.description: Optional hooks that give Claude DevOps project context at session start, ask before it edits secret or Terraform state files, and review infrastructure files after each edit.
